# RadioButtons

Header: `winui/ui/input/RadioButtons.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/input/RadioButtons.hpp`.

A headed group of mutually exclusive string options, as one element.

The control owns one [`RadioButton`](radio-button.md#uiradiobutton) per item ([`RadioGroup`](radio-button.md#class-radiogroup) coordinates loose buttons instead), lays them out column-major in up to [`max_columns()`](#max_columns) equal-sized columns, and selects by index. The group is a single tab stop; focus lands on the selected (or first enabled) item. Up/Down move to the previous/next enabled item and select it, Left/Right move between columns, Ctrl+arrow moves focus without selecting (Space then selects), and an arrow with nowhere to go inside the group moves focus out of it. [`ui::RadioButtons`](#uiradiobuttons) is the declarative form.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::string> message{"Nothing selected"};

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 12,
    .content  = {
        ui::RadioButtons{
            .header               = "Options:",
            .items                = {"Option 1", "Option 2", "Option 3"},
            .max_columns          = 2,
            .on_selection_changed = [&message](std::optional<std::size_t> index) {
                message = index ? std::format("You selected Option {}", *index + 1) : "";
            },
        },
        ui::Text{.text = message},
    },
});

// Imperatively:
auto colors = std::make_unique<ui::RadioButtonsControl>(
    std::vector<std::string>{"Red", "Green", "Blue"}, /*selected_index=*/0);
colors->set_header("Color");
colors->item(2)->set_enabled(false); // disable a single option
colors->on_selection_changed([](std::optional<std::size_t> index) { /* unset when cleared */ });
```

## `ui::RadioButtons`

A headed group of mutually exclusive options, one tab stop, selected by index. Builds a [ui::RadioButtonsControl](#uiradiobuttonscontrol).

The initial selection is in place before any handler is installed, so it raises nothing.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::optional<std::size_t>> background{0};

window.set_content(ui::RadioButtons{
    .header               = "Background",
    .items                = {"Green", "Yellow", "White"},
    .selected_index       = background,
    .max_columns          = 3,
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::RadioButtons{
    .header, .items, .selected_index, .max_columns, .style, .margin, .width, .height,
    .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility, .on_selection_changed,
    .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down,
    .on_wheel, .control
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uiradiobuttons-header"></span>`header` | `ui::Binding<std::string>` |  | The label above the group. Empty draws none. |
| <span id="uiradiobuttons-items"></span>`items` | `ui::Binding<std::vector<std::string>>` |  | One radio button per string, in order. Bound, a new list replaces the buttons and clears the selection. |
| <span id="uiradiobuttons-selected_index"></span>`selected_index` | `ui::TwoWayField<std::optional<std::size_t>>` |  | Unset (the default) selects nothing. |
| <span id="uiradiobuttons-max_columns"></span>`max_columns` | `ui::Binding<std::size_t>` | `{1}` | The most columns (at least 1). Items fill a column top to bottom before starting the next. |
| <span id="uiradiobuttons-on_selection_changed"></span>`on_selection_changed` | `ui::Callback<void(std::optional<std::size_t>)>` |  | The newly selected index (unset when cleared), after a click or Space. A bound value doesn't run it. |
| <span id="uiradiobuttons-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uiradiobuttons-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uiradiobuttons-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uiradiobuttons-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uiradiobuttons-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uiradiobuttons-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uiradiobuttons-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::RadioButtons>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |

Plus the common fields `style`, `margin`, `width`, `height`, `min_width`, `min_height`, `max_width`, `max_height`, `horizontal_alignment`, `vertical_alignment`, `visible`, `tool_tip`, `enabled`, `accessibility` every spec carries ([conventions](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)).

### RadioButtonsControl

```cpp
RadioButtonsControl() = default
```

An empty group with no header and nothing selected.

### RadioButtonsControl

```cpp
RadioButtonsControl(std::vector<std::string> items, std::optional<std::size_t> selected_index = std::nullopt)
```

One [RadioButton](radio-button.md#uiradiobutton) per string, in order, with [`selected_index`](#selected_index) checked (unset for none; no callback fires).

### header

```cpp
const std::string& header() const
```

The header above the items; also the automation name when none is set.

### set_header

```cpp
void set_header(std::string header)
```

The label above the options. Empty draws none and reserves no room for one.

### item_count

```cpp
std::size_t item_count() const
```

The number of options.

### item

```cpp
RadioButtonControl* item(std::size_t index) const
```

The button for item `index`, owned by this control; nullptr past the end.

### set_items

```cpp
void set_items(std::vector<std::string> items)
```

Replaces every item and clears the selection (firing on_selection_changed if there was one). The new buttons take this control's enabled state.

### selected_index

```cpp
std::optional<std::size_t> selected_index() const
```

The checked item; unset when none is.

### set_selected_index

```cpp
void set_selected_index(std::optional<std::size_t> index)
```

Checks that item and unchecks the one before. Unset, or anything outside [0, [item_count()](#item_count)), clears the selection. No-op, and no callback, when it does not change.

### selected_item

```cpp
std::string selected_item() const
```

The selected item's text, or an empty string.

### on_selection_changed

```cpp
void on_selection_changed(Callback<void(std::optional<std::size_t>)> handler)
```

Fired once per change with the new index (unset when cleared), whether a click, an arrow key, [`set_items()`](#set_items) or [`set_selected_index()`](#set_selected_index) caused it. Replaces any previous handler.

### max_columns

```cpp
std::size_t max_columns() const
```

The most columns items are laid out in; 1 by default. Fewer are used when the offered width cannot hold them.

### set_max_columns

```cpp
void set_max_columns(std::size_t columns)
```

Clamped to >= 1.

### focused

```cpp
bool focused() const
```

Whether the group has keyboard focus.

### focused_index

```cpp
std::optional<std::size_t> focused_index() const
```

The item that has the keyboard's attention while the group is focused; unset otherwise.

### focusable

```cpp
bool focusable() const override
```

A tab stop while enabled with at least one enabled item.

### for_each_child

```cpp
void for_each_child(ChildVisitor visit) const override
```

The items, in order.

### collect_focusables

```cpp
void collect_focusables(std::vector<Element*>& out) override
```

Lists only the group, as one tab stop. The arrow keys move between the items.

### automation_role

```cpp
AutomationRole automation_role() const override
```

Group; each item is its own SelectionItem.

### automation_name_fallback

```cpp
std::string automation_name_fallback() const override
```

The header, when no [`Accessibility::name`](../tree/accessibility.md#name) is set.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

The header plus a column-major grid of cells, each the size of the largest item, with 7 DIP column and 8 DIP row spacing.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Position children within the rect [arrange()](../tree/element.md#arrange) settled on (also in [bounds()](../tree/element.md#bounds), window DIPs). Default: nothing, for a leaf.

### pointer_override

```cpp
bool pointer_override(const PointerEvent& e) override
```

Routes clicks to the owned buttons.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws the header and every item.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

### focus_changed

```cpp
void focus_changed(bool focused) override
```

Keyboard focus arrived (true) or left (false); [is_focused()](../tree/element.md#is_focused) already says so. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

### key_override

```cpp
bool key_override(const KeyEvent& e) override
```

Arrow keys move the focused item (and select it unless Ctrl is held); Space selects it.

### focus_ring_rect

```cpp
Rect focus_ring_rect(const Theme& theme) const override
```

Around the focused item, as that item would ring itself.

### focus_ring_corner_radius

```cpp
float focus_ring_corner_radius(const Theme& theme) const override
```

The ring's corner radius: the theme's control radius by default.
